column1: Saddened and embarrased, you give Jack a moment to gain his composure. This also allows you to gather your own thoughts; you're not very good with expressing yourself sometimes.
column2: 你感到難過又尷尬，給 Jack 一點時間平復情緒。這也讓你能整理一下自己的思緒；你有時候不太擅長表達自己。

column1: Anyway, I don't know what to do. I try to talk to her, and she just screams at me and slams the door in my face.
column2: 反正，我不知道該怎麼辦。我試著跟她說話，她卻對我尖叫，然後當著我的面甩上門。

column1: Oh, man, Jack, I--
column2: 噢，天啊，Jack，我——

column1: Whu?--Oh, Sonny. What did you say?
column2: 啥？——噢，Sonny。你剛才說什麼？

column1: Jack has obviously been drinking way too much.
column2: Jack 顯然喝得太多了。

column1: We caught the creep who was dealing to Kathy, Jack. He's a slimy little punk named Donald P. Colby. We've got him, Jack. His eggs are gonna fry.
column2: 我們抓到賣毒品給 Kathy 的那個混蛋了，Jack。他是個叫 Donald P. Colby 的下流小混混。我們逮到他了，Jack。他死定了。

column1: Tha'ss just swell, Sonny. 'Cept it doesn't matter. Nothing matters. I'ss too late.
column2: 那……那真好啊，Sonny。可是這都不重要了。什麼都不重要了。太……太遲了。

column1: Too late?! My God, Jack, what do you mean?
column2: 太遲了？！天啊，Jack，你這是什麼意思？

column1: Kathy's in the hospital. In a coma. It was an overdose--some filthy shhh...they don't even know what. She might die, Sonny, my baby might die. Oh, no, why didn't I see it sooner? Oh God, Sonny...
column2: Kathy 在醫院裡。昏迷了。是用藥過量——某種下三濫的爛東西……他們連是什麼都不知道。她可能會死，Sonny，我的寶貝女兒可能會死。噢，不，我怎麼沒早點發現？天啊，Sonny……

column1: Hey, Jack, you're in no shape to drive--
column2: 嘿，Jack，你現在不能開車——

column1: Don't worry about it, Sonny, I called a cab for him.
column2: 別擔心，Sonny，我幫他叫了一輛計程車。

column1: I'm perfeckly fine, Bobby, I don' need a ride.
column2: 我好……好得很，Bobby，我不需要人載。

column1: Wait, Jack. Just hold on--
column2: 等等，Jack。你先等一下——

column1: You'd better go, Sonny. You know how mad Dooley gets if you're late.
column2: 你最好走了，Sonny。你知道 Dooley 遲到會有多生氣。

column1: Leave Keith alone. You have more important things to do.
column2: 別去煩 Keith 了。你有更重要的事要做。

column1: You may be tempted to whack Keith right now, but restrain yourself.
column2: 你現在可能很想揍 Keith 一頓，但還是忍住吧。

column1: It's your buddy, officer Keith Mandel.
column2: 是你的哥兒們，Keith Mandel 警員。

column1: Okay, I'll switch back with you...
column2: 好啦，我跟你換回來……

column1: NOT! Ha ha, you better run, Sonny!
column2: 才怪！哈哈，你最好快跑，Sonny！

column1: Don't worry about the plant, Bonds. Someone else will water it.
column2: 別管那盆植物了，Bonds。會有別人幫忙澆水的。

column1: The plant in the corner looks like it could use a stiff drink.
column2: 角落那盆植物看起來很需要來一杯烈酒。

column1: Patrons of The Blue Room have often been found talking to inanimate objects, pink elephants, giant purple lizards, etc. But fortunately, you're not inebriated.
column2: Blue Room 的常客常常被發現對著沒生命的東西、粉紅色大象、紫色巨蜥之類的講話。但幸好，你沒有喝醉。

column1: You're inside the Blue Room, a popular hangout for cops.
column2: 你正在 Blue Room 裡面，這裡是警察們最愛聚集的地方。

column1: It's on the other side of the glass, Bonds.
column2: 它在玻璃的另一邊，Bonds。

column1: It says MOOR EULB EHT.
column2: 上面寫著 MOOR EULB EHT。

column1: Sonny! Sonny, I need to talk to you!
column2: Sonny！Sonny，我需要跟你談談！

column1: What's up, Keith?
column2: 怎麼了，Keith？

column1: What?!
column2: 什麼？！

column1: You hear the honking of a cab outside.
column2: 你聽到外面傳來計程車的喇叭聲。

column1: There's your cab, Jack. Go ahead and take it, okay?
column2: 你的車來了，Jack。上車吧，好嗎？

column1: Oh, hell, Sonny, I don't need...ah, crap. All right. I'll do it.
column2: 噢，見鬼，Sonny，我不需要……啊，可惡。好吧，我坐就是了。

column1: Thanks, Jack. She'll be okay, you'll see.
column2: 謝了，Jack。她會沒事的，你等著看吧。

column1: Yeah. See ya, Sonny.
column2: 嗯。再見了，Sonny。

column1: Hey hey hey, where's the birthday boy! There he is! Jack, dude! Happy day!
column2: 嘿嘿嘿，壽星在哪裡啊！他在那邊！Jack，老兄！生日快樂啊！

column1: Hi, Keith. How's it going?
column2: 嗨，Keith。最近怎麼樣？

column1: Hi, Keith.
column2: 嗨，Keith。

column1: You guys look like you're ready for a funeral. Cheer up, dudes! It's not the end of the world, Jack. Plenty of other guys have turned 87, ha ha ha!
column2: 你們兩個看起來像要去參加葬禮一樣。振作點，老兄們！又不是世界末日，Jack。多的是人都活到 87 歲了，哈哈哈！

column1: You should talk, Keith, my boy. I've seen you popping your dentures in the locker room when nobody's looking.
column2: 你還好意思說呢，Keith 小老弟。我可看過你趁沒人注意的時候，在更衣室裡把假牙拔出來。

column1: Not me, dude! I'm a stud among muffins. You, on the other hand, are a little girly-cop.
column2: 才不是我咧，老兄！我在馬子堆裡可是搶手貨。倒是你，簡直就是個娘娘腔警察。

column1: Watch it, Keith. If Laura heard you saying that, she'd kick your butt sky-high.
column2: 小心點，Keith。要是被 Laura 聽到你這樣講，她會把你踢到天上去。

column1: Wow, the stone speaks! It's alive! Hey! Hey, Bobby! Put on the music, quick!
column2: 哇，石頭居然開口說話了！它活過來了！嘿！嘿，Bobby！快放音樂！

column1: Happy birthday, Jack, baby!
column2: 生日快樂，Jack，寶貝！

column1: Yow! Kayleigh, baby, you're the best! Shake it one time for me, honey!
column2: 哇喔！Kayleigh，寶貝，你最棒了！為我搖一下嘛，甜心！

column1: See you later, boys.
column2: 待會見了，各位。

column1: Happy birthday, Jack!
column2: 生日快樂，Jack！

column1: Huh? Oh, Clarice, thank you! Thank you, guys, this is great.
column2: 嗯？噢，Clarice，謝謝你！謝謝大家，這真是太棒了。

column1: You're a culinary angel, Clarice. Will you have my babies?
column2: 你簡直是廚藝天使，Clarice。要不要幫我生小孩？

column1: No, honey, I have too much respect for the gene pool to do that.
column2: 不要啦，甜心，我對基因庫的尊重可不允許我這麼做。

column1: Ouch, you've been body-slammed, Keith!
column2: 哎唷，你被摔得慘兮兮了，Keith！

column1: What did she say?
column2: 她說了什麼？

column1: She said you were a stud among muffins, buddy.
column2: 她說你在馬子堆裡是搶手貨，老兄。

column1: Ha ha ha, Sonny. Way funny. You know what else is funny? You agreed to swap shifts with me last week, remember? You're due in for briefing in ten minutes! Now THAT's funny!
column2: 哈哈哈，Sonny。真好笑。你知道還有什麼更好笑的嗎？你上禮拜答應要跟我換班，記得嗎？你十分鐘後就要去開簡報會了！這才叫好笑！

column1: Oh, hell, I forgot. Listen, Jack, I gotta cruise. If you need anything, give me a call, okay?
column2: 噢，見鬼，我忘了。聽著，Jack，我得閃了。有什麼需要就打給我，好嗎？

column1: Okay, Sonny. Thanks.
column2: 好，Sonny。謝了。

column1: You see your friend, Jack Cobb, sitting at the table. You've noticed that he's been depressed and distracted for days.
column2: 你看到你的朋友 Jack Cobb 坐在桌邊。你注意到他這幾天一直悶悶不樂、心不在焉。

column1: Have a seat, buddy.
column2: 坐吧，老兄。

column1: Why are you hanging around the Blue Room, Bonds? An escaped felon is loose in the city, and Lt. Morgan wants to see you NOW!
column2: 你怎麼還在 Blue Room 閒晃，Bonds？有個逃犯正在城裡逍遙法外，Morgan 中尉現在就要見你！

column1: Hey, Sonny, why don' you siddown? I don't wanna strain my neck lookin' up at ya.
column2: 嘿，Sonny，你怎麼不坐下？我可不想抬頭看你抬到脖子痠。

column1: Ah, the feel of vinyl.
column2: 啊，乙烯基的觸感。

column1: Barstools, made from the finest Corinthian naugahyde. Over 15 Naugas died to make these stools.
column2: 吧檯椅，用最頂級的科林斯人造皮革製成。為了做這些椅子，犧牲了超過 15 頭「Nauga」。

column1: You run your hand over the smooth surface of the wood. It comes away smelling like beer.
column2: 你用手撫過光滑的木頭表面。手上沾了一股啤酒味。

column1: The table is sturdy and reliable. It could use a wipedown, though.
column2: 這張桌子很堅固可靠，不過該擦一擦了。

column1: Unlike the one at Caffeine Carol's, this window is clean. Kindly keep your fingerprints off of it.
column2: 跟 Carol 咖啡城堡那扇不同，這扇窗戶很乾淨。麻煩別留下指紋。

column1: You can see the moderately busy street outside The Blue Room. It's one of the many you patrol.
column2: 你能看到 Blue Room 外面車水馬龍的街道。這是你眾多巡邏路線之一。

column1: It's not going to open without the jaws of life. The emergency crew will need to handle this.
column2: 沒有救命剪是打不開的。得交給救難隊處理。

column1: The door was compressed from the sudden impact.
column2: 車門在猛烈撞擊下已經整個變形。

column1: A closer glance reveals several slug holes just below the window. The clean and completely rust-free surface indicates that this is freshly exposed. It would appear that the driver had outside assistance in executing this unorthodox parking technique.
column2: 仔細一看，車窗下方有幾個彈孔。表面乾淨、完全沒有生鏽，看得出是新造成的。看來這名駕駛在完成這套非正統的停車手法時，得到了外力的「協助」。

column1: There's nothing you can do for the car. It's dead, Bonds.
column2: 這輛車已經沒救了。它報銷了，Bonds。

column1: Lightpole 1, vehicle 0. Many systems of the car which had previously been hidden from sight are now exposed and bleeding their own particular brand of vital fluid.
column2: 燈柱 1 分，車子 0 分。這輛車原本藏在裡面的許多系統，現在全都暴露出來，各自流著自己那份「命脈」。

column1: Forget about opening it. They don't pay you to wrangle sharp, twisted metal unless life is at stake. In this case, it's too late for such efforts.
column2: 別想打開它了。除非有性命危險，否則沒人付你薪水去跟扭曲的尖銳金屬搏鬥。這種情況，一切努力都已經太遲了。

column1: The force of the wreck has affected the entire car frame to the point of actually buckling the trunk lid. A quick glance inside indicates nothing out of the ordinary.
column2: 撞擊的力道大到讓整個車架變形，連後車廂蓋都凹了進去。快速看了一眼裡面，沒有發現異常。

column1: Careful. You don't want someone yelling `Police Brutality'.
column2: 小心點。你可不希望有人大喊「警察暴力」。

column1: A cross section of average Lyttonians is gathered here to gawk at the scene. One guy seems to be talking more than the others.
column2: 一群普通的 Lytton 市民聚在這裡看熱鬧。其中一個人講話似乎特別多。

column1: EXCUSE ME!
column2: 不好意思！

column1: Yeah, uh, I saw the whole thing, officer!
column2: 是啊，呃，整件事我都看到了，警官！

column1: A young, lean, nervous fellow steps forward.
column2: 一個年輕、瘦削、神情緊張的傢伙走上前來。

column1: Despite your queries, nobody steps forward. Apparently nobody else in the crowd saw -- or will admit to having seen -- anything.
column2: 儘管你不斷詢問，卻沒有人願意站出來。看來人群裡沒有其他人看到——或者說，沒有人願意承認自己看到——任何事情。

column1: You have more important things to take care of, not the least of which is your waistline.
column2: 你有更重要的事要處理，其中之一就是你的腰圍問題。

column1: It's a donut shop. It's not your favorite, but it does in a pinch. They'll do a good business this afternoon.
column2: 這是一間甜甜圈店。不是你最愛的那間，但緊急時湊合用。今天下午他們生意應該不錯。

column1: Poking Dooley won't help you up the departmental ladder.
column2: 戳 Dooley 一下對你在局裡升官沒有任何幫助。

column1: It's Mister Personality, Sgt. Dooley. You're certain he knows more than a little about the donut shop.
column2: 這位就是「萬人迷先生」，Dooley 警佐。你很確定他對這間甜甜圈店可不只是略知一二。

column1: Hello, Sonny. Lieutenant Hamilton is taking over the scene. You can go ahead and hit the streets.
column2: 你好，Sonny。Hamilton 中尉會接手現場。你可以上街去了。

column1: Sonny, you can get back out on patrol now.
column2: Sonny，你現在可以回去巡邏了。

column1: Sonny, you're trying my patience. Get your butt on patrol!
column2: Sonny，你在考驗我的耐性。把你的屁股弄回去巡邏！

column1: You can't open it by hand, but fortunately, there's no need to.
column2: 你沒辦法徒手打開它，不過幸好也用不著。

column1: It's a fire hydrant. Dog may be Man's best friend, but Fire Hydrant is really Dog's best bud.
column2: 這是一座消防栓。狗或許是人類最好的朋友，但消防栓才是狗真正的好哥兒們。

column1: They're just fine the way they are.
column2: 它們維持原樣就好了。

column1: Some safety-conscious -- and well-equipped -- citizen has placed flares around the wreck.
column2: 某位很有安全意識、裝備也齊全的市民，已經在事故車周圍擺了警示燈。

column1: You've got duties to perform. You can purchase posies later.
column2: 你有勤務要執行。買花的事等以後再說吧。

column1: Perhaps if you'd stop by the flower shop once in awhile, you wouldn't be alone so much. Your dashing uniform just isn't enough, Bonds.
column2: 要是你偶爾去一趟花店，或許就不會這麼常孤家寡人了。光靠這身帥氣的制服是不夠的，Bonds。

column1: Leave the detective alone to perform his duties. That's something you might give some thought to yourself, Bonds.
column2: 讓警探自己去執行他的勤務吧。你自己其實也該想想這件事，Bonds。

column1: That's Lieutenant Hamilton of Homicide. You've only worked with him a few times.
column2: 那位是命案組的 Hamilton 中尉。你只跟他共事過幾次。

column1: Leave the detective to his work. Any information you may have can be submitted to him later by report.
column2: 讓警探專心處理他的工作。你手上有的任何資訊，都可以之後用報告的方式呈報給他。

column1: The pole won't budge.
column2: 那根柱子紋風不動。

column1: The light post has sustained moderate damage but is still operational, unlike the car.
column2: 這根燈柱受到中度損壞，但還能正常運作，不像那輛車。

column1: There's nothing you can do to help the car.
column2: 你幫不了這輛車什麼忙了。

column1: The vehicle's a mess. That's usually the case for cars that try to hug light poles.
column2: 這輛車一團亂。試圖跟燈柱來個熱情擁抱的車，通常都是這副下場。

column1: There's nothing down there that is pertinent to this case. Do your shopping another time, officer.
column2: 那邊沒有任何東西跟這個案子有關。逛街的事改天再說吧，警官。

column1: Other shops line the street.
column2: 街道兩旁還有其他商店。

column1: The plate's fine where it is.
column2: 車牌留在原處就好。

column1: The plate on the car reads 2SPLAT.
column2: 這輛車的車牌寫著 2SPLAT。

column1: Dispatch, 83-32 is on scene at the 11-80. 83-32 out.
83-32, we copy. Dispatch out.
column2: 83-32，收到。調度台，通話結束。

column1: Dispatch, this is 83-32. The driver is 11-44. We'll need a meat wagon. 83-32 out.
column2: 調度台，這裡是 83-32。駕駛是 11-44。我們需要一輛屍體運送車。83-32，通話結束。

column1: Dispatch copies, 83-32. Sgt. Dooley is enroute and will be in charge once he arrives. Dispatch out.
column2: 調度台收到，83-32。Dooley 警佐正在前往途中，抵達後將由他負責指揮。調度台，通話結束。

column1: Dispatch, this is 83-32. My 10-20 is near the corner of Fig and 4th. 83-32 out.
column2: 調度台，這裡是 83-32。我的 10-20 位置在 Fig 街與第四街的路口附近。83-32，通話結束。

column1: This is normally a quiet street lined with small, quiet shops. Today, the normal course of events have been interrupted.
column2: 這條街平常很安靜，兩旁都是些小小的安靜商店。今天，這裡的日常秩序被打亂了。

column1: That would be unsafe. Better let it cool down.
column2: 那樣做不安全。最好讓它先冷卻下來。

column1: Steam rushes from the breached radiator.
column2: 蒸氣從破裂的水箱中猛烈噴出。

column1: Leave the sample-gathering to the detectives, Bonds. There's nothing on the street you need.
column2: 採集樣本的事交給警探們去做吧，Bonds。街上沒有你需要的東西。

column1: Skid marks lead up to the lightpole. You wince; you can almost hear the screaming tires.
column2: 煞車痕一路延伸到燈柱前。你不禁皺眉；幾乎能聽見輪胎尖銳的摩擦聲。

column1: No pulse. No vital signs whatsoever. Your worst fear is confirmed. This guy just booked a one-drawer stainless steel suite at the Toe-Tag Motel.
column2: 沒有脈搏，完全沒有任何生命跡象。你最擔心的事得到了證實。這傢伙已經在「腳趾標籤汽車旅館」訂好一間不鏽鋼抽屜套房了。

column1: You do the smart thing and check twice for signs of life. But this man's as dead as any man you've ever seen.
column2: 你很明智地檢查了兩次生命跡象。但這個人已經死透了，跟你見過的任何死人一樣徹底。

column1: There is a head injury as well as a small hole near the jaw. Both of them are slowly trickling blood. He doesn't appear to be breathing.
column2: 他頭部有傷，下顎附近也有一個小洞。兩處都緩緩滲著血。他似乎已經沒有呼吸了。

column1: He doesn't look any better.
column2: 他看起來一點都沒有比較好。

column1: There is no answer.
column2: 沒有任何回應。

column1: You only need to talk to the witness. You have no reason to touch him.
column2: 你只需要跟目擊者談話。你沒有理由碰他。

column1: The witness is a thin, white male, about 140 pounds. He seems a bit nervous.
column2: 目擊者是一名瘦削的白人男子，體重大約 140 磅。他看起來有點緊張。

column1: Could you please tell me what you saw and heard?
column2: 能不能請你告訴我，你看到和聽到了什麼？

column1: Okay, there was these bangs from the one other car and there was a big crash and crud's flyin' everywhere and this car crashed while this other car is jammin' outta here like a bat outta hell and I...
column2: 好，就是另一輛車傳來一陣砰砰聲，然後就一聲巨響，碎片到處亂飛，這輛車撞了，另一輛車就用飛快的速度衝出去，然後我……

column1: WHOA! Whoa. Slow down. Take a breath. Now, start at the beginning. When did you first notice something out of the ordinary and, where were you?
column2: 哇！哇，慢慢來。深呼吸一下。好，從頭開始說。你第一次注意到不對勁是什麼時候？當時你人在哪裡？

column1: Okay. I'm just cruisin' along to my chick's place. I'm, oh, 'bout a half block back up to the right there, okay. An' I hear these cars comin' up from behind and then one gets louder. They pass me comin' towards this direction an' get this, they're side-by-side!
column2: 好。我當時就開車要去我馬子家。我人大概在後面右邊半個街區那裡，好嗎。然後我聽到後面有車子開過來，其中一輛聲音越來越大。它們超過我朝這邊過來，然後你聽好，它們是並排開的！

column1: He goes on to tell you how the two cars were alongside each other when he heard what might have been two shots. The car on the right swerved, colliding with the lightpole. The other car fled the scene at a high rate of speed.
column2: 他接著告訴你，兩輛車並排行駛時，他聽到了兩聲疑似槍響。右邊那輛車突然轉向，撞上了燈柱。另一輛車則以高速逃離現場。

column1: Could you describe the car? Did you happen to get the license plate number?
column2: 你能描述一下那輛車嗎？你有沒有剛好看到車牌號碼？

column1: Yeah, I saw part of it. I think it was.. oh crap.. what was it? Oh, yeah! L964 was part of it. I don't know about the rest. The car was a silver Mercedes. I'm not sure 'bout the year. It wasn't brand-new, but not real old either. I couldn't see the dude driving. He was on the far side of the whole mess and, y'know, there was a lot happenin' at once.
column2: 有，我看到一部分。我想是……噢靠……是什麼來著？噢對！L964 是其中一部分。剩下的我就不知道了。那輛車是銀色的賓士。年份我不太確定。不是全新的，但也沒有很舊。我看不到開車的那傢伙。他在整團混亂的另一側，而且，你知道的，當時一堆事情同時在發生。

column1: Thanks for your cooperation. Could you wait around for a few minutes? Lieutenant Hamilton might have a few more questions for you. Thanks.
column2: 謝謝你的配合。能不能請你在附近等幾分鐘？Hamilton 中尉可能還有幾個問題要問你。謝了。

column1: Yeah, sure, man. Glad I could help.
column2: 好啊，沒問題，老兄。很高興能幫上忙。

column1: You've learned all you can from the witness. Dooley can handle any further interrogation.
column2: 你已經從目擊者那裡問出所有能問的了。後續的偵訊交給 Dooley 處理就行。
